items.name: Finset.card_Iic_prod
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder α] [Preorder β] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] [LocallyFiniteOrderBot β] [DecidableLE (α × β)] (x : α × β) : (Finset.Iic x).card = (Finset.Iic x.1).card * (Finset.Iic x.2).card

items.name: Finsupp.card_Iic
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsBotZeroClass α] [OrderBot α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq α] (f : ι →₀ α) : (Finset.Iic f).card = ∏ i ∈ f.support, (Finset.Iic (f i)).card

items.name: Finset.card_Iic_finset
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] {s : Finset α} : (Finset.Iic s).card = 2 ^ s.card

items.name: DFinsupp.card_Iic
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [DecidableEq ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)] [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (α i)] [(i : ι) → PartialOrder (α i)] [∀ (i : ι), IsBotZeroClass (α i)] [(i : ι) → OrderBot (α i)] [(i : ι) → LocallyFiniteOrder (α i)] (f : Π₀ (i : ι), α i) : (Finset.Iic f).card = ∏ i ∈ f.support, (Finset.Iic (f i)).card

items.name: Multiset.card_Iic
items.type: {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) : (Finset.Iic s).card = ∏ i ∈ s.toFinset, (Multiset.count i s + 1)

items.name: Pi.card_Iic
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [(i : ι) → DecidableEq (α i)] [(i : ι) → PartialOrder (α i)] [(i : ι) → LocallyFiniteOrderBot (α i)] (b : (i : ι) → α i) : (Finset.Iic b).card = ∏ i, (Finset.Iic (b i)).card
